thought
The test image shows a sugarcane plant with numerous thin, narrow leaves, some of which are pale yellow to chlorotic, giving a bushy, grass-like appearance. The overall plant seems stunted with a proliferation of auxiliary buds. This strongly suggests symptoms of "Grassy_Shoot" or "Yellow_Leaf" based on the provided symptom descriptions.

Now, I will read the `part_index.md` file to confirm which plant parts are primarily affected by these diseases.

thought
The reference image for Grassy Shoot (LeafNet_136.jpg) shows a plant with many thin tillers and some yellowing leaves, which is quite similar to the test image's bushy, grass-like appearance and yellowed foliage. This reinforces "Grassy_Shoot" as a strong candidate.

Next, I will view a reference image for "Yellow_Leaf".

thought
The reference image for Yellow_Leaf (LeafNet_136.jpg) shows a completely yellowed and dried leaf, which doesn't resemble the test image as closely as "Grassy_Shoot". The test image shows yellowing but also a prominent bushy, tillering habit.

Next, I will view a reference image for "Pokkah_Boeng", even though it seems less likely, to ensure I cover the initial whole_plant candidates.

thought
The reference image for Pokkah_Boeng shows twisted and malformed leaves, which is not the primary symptom observed in the test image. The test image's main characteristic is the dense, grass-like tillering and overall bushy appearance with yellowing.

Given that I have 8 reference image views and have used 3, I need to use 5 more views, spread across different classes. I've already checked Grassy_Shoot, Yellow_Leaf, and Pokkah_Boeng.

I will now check Sett_Rot (the remaining "whole_plant" candidate) and then start looking at leaf diseases, prioritizing those that have some yellowing or spots as per the test image.

Next, I will view a reference image for "Sett_Rot".

The reference image for Sett_Rot shows dried out, discolored stems and leaves, which is not consistent with the bushy, tillering appearance of the test image.

So far, "Grassy_Shoot" is the strongest candidate. I have used 4 out of 8 views. I need to use 4 more views, spreading them across different remaining classes.

I will now view reference images for "Brown_Spot", "Yellow_Spot", "Leaf_Scald", and "Streak_Mosaic_Scsmv" as they are leaf diseases and the test image shows leaf symptoms as well.

thought
The reference image for Brown_Spot (LeafNet_1006.jpg) shows a single reddish-brown spot on a leaf. This is not consistent with the widespread yellowing and bushy growth observed in the test image.

I have used 5 out of 8 views. I need 3 more views. I will now view reference images for "Yellow_Spot", "Leaf_Scald", and "Streak_Mosaic_Scsmv".

thought
The reference image for Yellow_Spot (SugarLeaf_ID_136.jpg) shows distinct yellow spots on a green leaf. This is not the primary symptom in the test image, which exhibits more general yellowing and a bushy growth habit rather than discrete spots.

I have used 6 out of 8 views. I need 2 more views. I will now view reference images for "Leaf_Scald" and "Streak_Mosaic_Scsmv".
